output.summary: A genus of succulent perennials of subtropical origin, houseleeks occur from Morocco to Iran across mountain ranges and parts of the Sahara and Caucasus. They form mats of thick-leaved rosettes and spread by offsets; each rosette dies after flowering, usually leaving many offsets behind.
output.edibilityNote: Houseleek juice was used in medieval Arabic cooking to colour food pink, or mixed with saffron for a deeper yellow.
